name: Compucase Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Compucase Enterprise Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures PC cases, power supplies, and rackmount chassis worldwide. It also offers cabinets. In addition, the company engages in the manufacture and sale of medical devices and equipment, computers, server chassis, computer parts and accessories, keyboards, scanners, dies, Speaker Diaphragm Paper and Spider, Silk Yarn, Voice Coil and Diaphragm, and other components; sale of computer components; cutting and processing of iron materials; and the import and export of electronics, optoelectronics, and precision dies and plastic injectors, as well as general investment business.
